import polars as pl
import io

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "salary": [50000.0, 60000.0, 75000.0]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory (bytes buffer)
buffer = io.BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the bytes
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nSerialized size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from bytes buffer
buffer.seek(0)
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Confirm round trip
assert df.equals(df_restored), "Round trip failed - DataFrames are not equal"
print("\n✓ Round trip successful - DataFrames are identical")
